notes.title: Routine Maintenance
notes.content:
Hello,

In order to maintain optimal quality and provide the best experience possible, Second Galaxy will undergo routine update maintenance at 22:00 February 24th 2020 (GT). The maintenance is expected to last 60 minutes. This duration is an estimation and subject to change. While the maintenance is underway, you'll be unable to log in. Please make sure you log off before the maintenance begins to avoid losing any progress.

We're sorry for any inconvenience this may cause, and will issue compensation once the maintenance is complete.

After the update is completed, you will receive the following rewards: Illegal Miners' Ore Container*100, Credits*240K .

This update mainly includes:
1. Optimized server stability.

Thank you for understanding, and for supporting Second Galaxy. Enjoy your adventure among the stars!
